name: Neck Oil
review: Crisp, citrusy and dangerously easy to drink. The sort of pint that accidentally becomes three.
alt: Placeholder image for a pint of Neck Oil

venue.name: The Old Brewery
venue.review: Fair price, properly poured, and actually feels like somewhere you want to sit for another one. Strong pub.

name: Punk IPA
review: Still a solid fridge beer. Hoppy enough to feel interesting without turning dinner into a botanical experiment.

venue.name: The Hop Room
venue.review: A little expensive for what it is, but the beer was treated properly and the place had a decent atmosphere.

name: Mystery Pub Lager
review: Cold. Wet. Technically beer. Did the job, but nobody is writing poetry about it.
alt: Placeholder image for a lager pint

venue.name: The Station Arms
venue.review: The pint arrived alive, which is something. Too expensive, average pour, and the venue had all the charm of a delayed train.
